Information.Description: Androstenedione can cause cancer according to The National Toxicology Program.
Information.DescriptionSourceName: California Office of Environmental Health Hazard Assessment (OEHHA)

Information.Description: Androst-4-ene-3,17-dione is a 3-oxo 4-steroid that is androst-4-ene substituted by oxo groups at positions 3 and 17. It is a steroid hormone synthesized in the adrenal glands and gonads. It has a role as an androgen, a mouse metabolite, a human metabolite and a Daphnia magna metabolite. It is a 17-oxo steroid, a 3-oxo-Delta(4) steroid and an androstanoid.
